description: User-controlled values interpolated into a MongoDB $where clause via template literal at lines 73-78 of getAllocationsByUserIdAndStocks. The fix uses parameterised filtering instead of string-interpolated $where.
User input from req.body.preTax / afterTax / roth is passed directly to eval(). The comment in the source explicitly marks the lines as 'Insecure use of eval() to parse inputs'.
Validation regex /([0-9]+)+\#/ on bankRouting uses nested greedy quantifiers; the source comments explicitly identify this as catastrophic-backtracking-prone.
handleProfileUpdate destructures untrusted req.body fields directly into the profile-update DAO call without an allowlist of writable fields, permitting overwrite of privileged columns.

bcrypt-nodejs is a pure-JS bcrypt port that has been deprecated and is recognised as a security-relevant outdated dependency; the README of the package itself recommends migrating to bcrypt or bcryptjs.

type: Stack Trace Disclosure in Error Response
description: The error route renders the full error object (including stack) into the template, exposing sensitive runtime information to clients.

The tutorial route iterates a list of pages and renders res.render(`tutorial/${page}`); the route parameter is used to construct a template path, enabling template path injection attacks if the page list is bypassed.
